verdict.rationale: Gumloop's 'Skills' are described as reusable instruction/knowledge packs that agents can use and that can be centrally managed and shared across an organization (gumloop-docs-4, gumloop-docs-36, gumloop-docs-52), which is the closest analog to a reusable module. However, there is no explicit documentation of one workflow/agent invoking another as a callable sub-workflow (i.e., composition where an agent or workflow triggers another as a discrete reusable unit within its own execution graph). Missing for 10: explicit sub-workflow/child-workflow invocation mechanics, evidence of nesting or passing structured I/O between workflows, and any hands-on example of a workflow calling another workflow.
